sdk_free_runtime.scope: fresh 05a verified installed package path in retained SDK-free pinned Ubuntu runtime userspace; reused unchanged pinned headless build userspace with reconfigured retained 05a final build directories; isolated network; shared WSL kernel; writable rootfs

wsl_repair_result.cause: The /proc child retirement read raced actual process disappearance and raised ESRCH/ProcessLookupError rather than ENOENT/FileNotFoundError. Production child containment succeeded; the test observation helper handled only the latter.
wsl_repair_result.change: Catch both precise disappearance exceptions; require PermissionError and generic OSError to propagate; existing state checks remain.

sanitizer_dependency_repair.cause: NVRHI static libraries lacked the MSVC ASan instrumentation used by engine consumers, producing STL annotation mismatches at link time.
sanitizer_dependency_repair.change: Apply the existing selected sanitizer helper to both nvrhi and nvrhi_vk targets; retain dependency warning policy and enabled STL annotations.

intermediate_wsl_source_drift.reason: The CMake sanitizer integration was repaired while this WSL run was active. Its source-drift gate failed; final qualification uses the complete subsequent verified run.

limits: 05a qualifies owned instance/surface/device/NVRHI creation, capability selection, validation diagnostics and teardown only. Full REQ-05 remains NOT_RUN; 05b owns presentation, submission, frames in flight and retirement; 05c owns final failure/stress qualification.

Current Windows 11 PC RTX 4070 Laptop and Intel Raptor Lake-S Mobile GPUs, plus existing WSL2 Ubuntu userspaces only. No native Linux graphics, other hardware, hosted CI, production MMO capacity or release claim.

Three Windows suites each pass 33 CTests; two WSL client suites each pass 32; two WSL headless suites each pass 24. All graphics-device families execute 29 seeded CPU cases without family skips. Existing overlapping frame/window tags must not be summed.

Seven validation-required GPU smoke runs each create and close 16 devices: both GPUs in Debug, Release and ASan, plus Debug automatic selection. Every cycle retains zero warning/error/dropped diagnostics including teardown. No draw, compute, readback, GPU submission or presentation is exposed in 05a.

Inventory is capability discovery, not graphical rendering evidence. Validation-off execution remains NOT_RUN for qualification. Missing UUID and missing required validation are expected exit-1 capability failures.

Three native window smokes each retain 11 cases and 17 engine-window lifetimes, plus actual bounded Runtime/Editor launches. These cover current DPI and targeted synthetic Win32 callbacks, not physical input or other monitors.

Native driver/OS calls are not preemptible in-process. The graphics smoke has an external 60-second process-tree watchdog; the standard-user launch wrapper has a separate 90-second bound. No GPU submissions exist, so native teardown has no submitted work to wait for in this increment.

Core/Server remain outside client dependency discovery/fetch/link/package closures. Windows native clients now share the exact pinned GLFW/NVRHI/Vulkan sources; device-free and WSL clients use unavailable adapters. Pinned dependency revisions, locked options and patches are unchanged; lock ownership metadata changed and NVRHI now uses the selected sanitizer.

An initial WSL tooling fixture observed a disappearing /proc child while checking owned descendant cleanup and failed. Its failed receipt is retained. A narrow fixture repair with a deterministic regression and complete final Windows/WSL reruns qualifies the final source state; no failure is relabeled as a pass.

Initial Windows ASan linking failed because NVRHI and engine objects disagreed on STL annotations. The selected sanitizer now instruments both NVRHI static targets without disabling annotations or changing dependency warning policy. The original failed link log is retained alongside the final passing ASan suite and native runs.

An intermediate WSL rerun detected the concurrently repaired CMake input and remains a failed source-consistency qualification. The final verified rerun reconfigures, rebuilds and executes the complete suite against unchanged final inputs.
SDK-free Server smoke runs in the retained pinned Ubuntu runtime userspace with an isolated network and shared WSL kernel. This is current-machine package evidence, not an independent clean machine.

Platform-specific tooling fixtures retain declared internal skips. Core/input/window/frame/graphics families have no skips. Optional probe CPU CLI/report regression adds two passing CTests, reported separately from the 211-test matrix.

No driver, host package, WSL resource setting, hosted workflow or remote branch policy changed. Nothing staged, committed or pushed. Existing gitignore rules cover generated outputs and the local roadmap.
